arabic text: BAAD-E-HUSSAIN KIS NE KAHA MAIN YATEEM HOON\nMAQTAL SAY ARAHI HAY SADA MAIN YATEEM HOON
english translation text: After Hussain, who said: I am an orphan?\nA voice comes from the battlefield: I am an orphan.

arabic text: JO HAY WO ZULM KARTA HAY MAJBOOR JAAN KAR\nSHAYED YEHI HAY MERI KHATA MAY YATEMM HOON
english translation text: Everyone oppresses me, knowing I am helpless.\nPerhaps this alone is my fault: I am an orphan.

arabic text: BABA KAY SAAT GHOOMNAY PHIRNAY KI UMR THI\nTOOTA HAR EK KHWAB MERA MAIN YATEEM HOON
english translation text: It was the age to walk and travel beside Baba;\nevery dream of mine has shattered—I am an orphan.

arabic text: RO KAR KAHA SAKINA NAY LAASH-E-HUSSAIN PAR\nAB JAKAY YE YAKEEN HUA MAIN YATEEM HOON
english translation text: Weeping over Hussain's body, Sakina said:\nonly now have I truly understood that I am an orphan.

arabic text: BOLI SAKINA SHIMR SAY KANON PAY RAKH KAY HAAT\nGOHAR NA CHEEN BEHRAY KHUDA MAIN YATEEM HOON
english translation text: Placing her hands over her ears, Sakina said to Shimr:\ndo not snatch my earrings, for God's sake—I am an orphan.

arabic text: HASNA THO DOOR RONAY BHI DAYTA NAHI KOHI\nKUCH IQTIYAR HI NA RAHA MAIN YATEEM HOON
english translation text: Far from laughter, no one even allows me to weep;\nI have no power left—I am an orphan.

arabic text: MAIN APNAY ASOUON SAY BUJHA LOUNGI APNI PYAAS\nDARIYA SAY LAUT AAO CHACHA MAIN YATEEM HOON
english translation text: I will quench my thirst with my own tears;\nreturn from the river, Uncle—I am an orphan.

arabic text: SAR RAKH DIYA SAKINA NAY ZAINAB KI GOAD MAY\nRAKHNA PHUPI KHAYAAL MERA MAIN YATEEM HOON
english translation text: Sakina placed her head in Zainab's lap:\nAunt, take care of me—I am an orphan.

arabic text: MAQTAL SAY SU-E-SHAAM YEH KEHTI HUI CHALI\nBABA MERA SHAHEED HUA MAIN YATEEM HOON
english translation text: From the battlefield towards Shaam she walked, saying:\nmy father has been martyred—I am an orphan.
